card.name: Linking words before treatment-course terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (after, of, if) and spaces that follow a time span or a caution sentence in label text, just before words like initiation, treatment or a condition clause.

modes.label: After a time span
modes.description: The word 'after' or 'of' following a number of hours, days or weeks, leading into starting treatment.
modes.example: Electrocardiograms should be performed at baseline, 7 days<< after>> initiation of nilotinib capsules,

modes.label: Sentence-opening If
modes.description: 'If' starting a new sentence after a renal or treatment-duration caution.
modes.example: Avoid the use of diclofenac external in patients with advanced renal disease unless the benefits are expected to outweigh the risk of worsening renal function.<< If>> diclofenac is used in patients

modes.label: Space after 'as little as'
modes.description: The space before a small amount in an overdose statement.
modes.example: Toxic doses of chloroquine can be fatal. As little as<< >>1 g may be fatal in children.

card.writes: It suppresses 'effect' words, so it steers the next word away from 'effect' wording.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words about when something happens after starting a drug, or on a conditional 'if' in warnings.
